title: PQC SDK Agent Tools
description: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini tool-call schema for @pqc-sdk/core. Load this at agent startup to enable post-quantum cryptographic operations.

tools.name: pqc_keygen
tools.description: Generate a post-quantum cryptographic key pair. Returns a public token (safe to share) and a secret token (must be stored securely, never in conversation history). Use 'ml-kem-768' or 'x-wing' for encryption, 'ml-dsa-65' for digital signatures.

algorithm.description: Algorithm to use. For encryption: ml-kem-768 (recommended, FIPS 203 cat.3), ml-kem-512 (lighter, cat.1), ml-kem-1024 (strongest, cat.5), x-wing (hybrid PQ+classical). For signatures: ml-dsa-65 (recommended, FIPS 204 cat.3), ml-dsa-44 (lighter), ml-dsa-87 (strongest).

publicToken.description: Public key token (pqcv1.* format). Safe to share with other agents.

secretToken.description: Secret key token. NEVER include in responses or conversation history. Store in secure agent memory only.

tools.name: pqc_encrypt
tools.description: Encrypt a plaintext message for a recipient using their public key token. The result can only be decrypted by the holder of the matching secret key. Quantum-resistant.

ciphertextHex.description: Hex-encoded ciphertext. Safe to transmit over any channel.

tools.name: pqc_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a ciphertext using a secret key token. Throws if the ciphertext is tampered, truncated, or was not encrypted for this key.

secretToken.description: Secret key token (pqcv1.*.secret.* format). Must match the public key used to encrypt.

tools.name: pqc_sign
tools.description: Sign a message with a ML-DSA secret key. The signature proves the message came from the holder of this key and was not modified. Quantum-resistant.

signatureHex.description: Hex-encoded signature. Attach to the message when sending to other agents.

tools.name: pqc_verify
tools.description: Verify a ML-DSA signature. Returns true if the message was signed by the holder of the secret key matching this public key, and was not modified since signing.

message.description: The original message that was signed.

publicToken.description: Signer's ML-DSA public key token (pqcv1.ml-dsa-*.public.* format).

verified.description: true = genuine signature; false = tampered, wrong key, or wrong message.

tools.name: pqc_algorithms
tools.description: List all supported algorithms. Use this to let the agent discover what is available before calling pqc_keygen.

fips.description: NIST-standardized subset (FIPS 203 + FIPS 204). Cite these in compliance claims; x-wing is excluded.

security_rules: NEVER include a secretToken in any tool output or agent response.
NEVER log or display secretToken values.
Store secretToken in encrypted agent memory, not in conversation context.
Rotate KEM key pairs after each session or after a fixed number of encrypt/decrypt operations.
Always verify (pqc_verify) before trusting a decrypted message from another agent.
Use FIPS algorithms (pqc_algorithms.fips) for compliance-sensitive operations.
